Community Nurse

10 Stillwater Street
Newtown

18/05/2019

Dear Mrs. Walters,

Re: Mrs. Dorris White, DOB: 01/04/1955                                                                   Commented [mg1]: D.O.B: -> American style


Thank you for seeing Mrs. Walters, who is being discharged today after sustaining a leg injury. Her      Commented [mg2]: White
condition would require watchful observation and frequent changing of her wound dressing.                Commented [mg3]: undergoing a skin graft with flap
                                                                                                         operation for a neglected leg injury

On 25/03/2019, Mrs. Walters presented with a traumatic leg injury which has been neglected. She
was given analgesia and the wound healing has not improved on antibiotics or surgical                    Commented [mg4]: but
debridement. On 17/04/2019, a surgical flap was applied to the wound to improve healing,                 Commented [mg5]: her
together with hyperbaric oxygen and negative pressure dressing. Over the following month, the            Commented [mg6]: did -> completed finished past event
wound healing and its blood supply has improved, reaching 70% today.
                                                                                                         Commented [mg7]: improve
                                                                                                         Commented [mg8]: have
Mrs. Walters has type two diabetes, hypertension, ischemic heart disease and peripheral heart
disease. She attends hemodialysis regularly for chronic renal failure and her medications include
insulin, Atorvastatin, aspirin and beta-blockers. Kindly note, the complete list of her medications is
attached. [Missing: Ankle-brachial pressure index improved to 70]

In light of the above, Mrs. Walters would require frequent change of wound dressing to prevent
wound infection and promote healing. Thank you for your care and continuous observation of Mrs.
Walters. I would be grateful if you could update me on her condition.

Yours sincerely,
Doctor
